snippet.title: Cardsharp - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Cardsharp is a blackjack-inspired game set in a dark room. Play solo or with friends. Win the hand and you get paid; lose it and the dealer takes a finger. Rob the other players, burn the card they were saving, push cursed items on them.
#buckshotroulettegame #indiegame #indiegames #steamgames 
Whishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5094940/Cardsharp
